desc: Derive the monotonic-stack representation for the cost of raising each element to the prefix maximum within the current window.
Design and verify efficient updates when extending the right boundary and removing elements as the left boundary advances.
Prove that the maintained cost equals the minimum increments needed to make every current subarray non-decreasing and that valid starts form a contiguous range.
Implement `countNonDecreasingSubarrays` in Python with O(n log n) complexity and careful handling of large values and the answer count.
Test the implementation on both examples, single-element arrays, already non-decreasing arrays, and cases requiring exactly or more than `k` operations.
